title: Selected Topics in History; Arts, Leisure, and Entertainment: Urban Life in Modern Iran
description:
Also offered as PERS398B JWST319I, and TDPS358B. Credit granted for PERS398B, HIST328C, JWST319I, or TDPS358B.

Interdisciplinary historical exploration of the formation and transformations of urban public culture in modern Iran. Taught in English.
